parties.petitioner: MANILAL SHAMALBHAI PATEL (DECEASED) THROUGH HIS LEGAL HEIRS & ORS.
parties.respondent: OFFICER ON SPECIAL DUTY (LAND ACQUISITION) & ANR.

summary: The appellants challenged the compensation awarded for their acquired agricultural land in Village Ranoli, Gujarat, arguing for enhancement based on the allotment of a nearby commercial plot at Rs.450 per sq. mt. and income from fruit-bearing trees. The Court considered the allotment of Plot No. 7/1 at Rs.180 per sq. mt. by GIDC as a benchmark, adjusted for price rise (5%) to Rs.190, then applied 50% deduction (40% for development, 10% for largeness) yielding Rs.95 per sq. mt. as fair compensation. The claim for income from trees was rejected due to lack of evidence. The High Court's order upholding Rs.30 per sq. mt. was set aside, and compensation was enhanced to Rs.95 per sq. mt. with statutory benefits.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act
Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act
Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act
Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act
Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act
final_judgment: The civil appeal is allowed; the compensation is enhanced to Rs.95 per sq. mt. with all statutory benefits including interest. The impugned judgment is set aside and the awards below are modified accordingly.
